hero.description: I implement, develop and integrate Odoo so the ERP fits the business, not the other way around: functional consulting, custom modules and integrations with any external system.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I hold a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, specialising in Software Engineering, which I completed in the bilingual (Spanish–English) track. I focus mainly on Odoo development and consulting: analysing business processes, implementing the ERP and building the modules and integrations each company needs.
about.p2: I have worked as a developer and functional consultant on Odoo projects in manufacturing, distribution, services and hospitality, connecting the ERP with access control, automated warehouses, PMS, e-commerce, telephony and banks. Beyond ERP, I also build my own products with AI, IoT and infrastructure.

odoo.title: Odoo · Consulting & Integrations
odoo.description: My main area of work. I support companies through the whole Odoo lifecycle: from process analysis and implementation to custom development, third-party integrations and production deployment.

consulting.title: Functional consulting & implementation
consulting.description: Process analysis and Odoo configuration so the ERP reflects how the business actually works.
highlights: Implementation of Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing (MRP), Accounting and HR
Spanish localisation: accounting and tax reports
User manuals, training and team support
Diagnosis and resolution of production incidents

modules.title: Custom module development
modules.description: Python, OWL and QWeb extensions covering what standard Odoo doesn't, following OCA best practices.
highlights: Milestone billing, sales commissions and per-work-centre manufacturing costs
Dynamic contracts, process flows with RACI matrix and user signatures
Customer portals, web self-assessments and e-learning courses
Team-based security, state change auditing and financial reports

integrations.title: Integrations with external systems
integrations.description: Connectors that sync Odoo with hardware, platforms and third-party services via API.
highlights: Access control and time tracking (BioStar) and automated vertical warehouses (Modula)
Hotel PMS (WuBook): invoice and booking export
E-commerce: sync with WordPress/WooCommerce and PrestaShop
VoIP telephony and online bank statement import

ai.title: AI applied to Odoo
ai.description: Bringing language models into the ERP to query and operate on business data.
highlights: Own MCP server to connect AI assistants to any Odoo instance
RAG system with OpenAI Vector Stores over company documentation
AI assistants embedded in ERP workflows

devops.title: Infrastructure & deployment
devops.description: Reproducible, maintainable Odoo environments, from development to production.
highlights: Deployments with Docker and Doodba, from Odoo Community to Enterprise
OCA addon management, migrations and version upgrades

vandio.title: Vandio · AI Concierge for Hotels & Rentals
vandio.description: AI-powered virtual concierge that automatically responds to guest inquiries 24/7 via WhatsApp, web chat, and Telegram. Built on a customizable knowledge base from property documents, it automates guest communication, reduces staffing needs, and enables seamless escalation to human agents.

rutas.title: Rutas · Delivery Route Management
rutas.description: Web application for managing delivery routes and stops, with user roles, route run tracking, payment methods, and an admin panel. Built for logistics and courier operations, enabling real-time status updates and full traceability of each delivery.

nebstala.title: Nebstala · Smart Domotics Management for STR
nebstala.description: A smart domotics management system for short-term rental (STR) properties, centralizing access control, climate management, and smart devices to automate operations, reduce energy consumption, and enhance the guest experience.

homelab.title: Home Lab Server
homelab.description: A self-hosted infrastructure for virtualization, containers, and service deployment, used as a development, testing, automation, and DevOps experimentation environment.

unitree.title: Unitree Robotics Integration
unitree.description: A quadruped robotics integration and control project, combining software, systems, and IoT for experimentation, automation, and advanced device control.

meshtastic.title: Meshtastic · Mesh Networking & LoRa
meshtastic.description: Deployment and configuration of LoRa-based mesh networks with Meshtastic, focused on decentralized, resilient, and long-range communications, integrating nodes, sensors, and custom services.

contact.title: Let's Talk
contact.subtitle: Do you have a project in mind or just want to chat? I'd love to hear from you.
